'''Gorn Vorrox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He [[Information broker/Legends|traded in information]] and stolen goods in the seedy [[Seelom District]] of [[Jyvus Space City|Jyvus City]], the largest [[City-ship/Legends|space city]] in orbit over [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Vorrox owned [[Gorn's Emporium]] which appeared to be little more than a junk shop, but truly dealt in illicit and exotic weapons and merchandise.<ref name="SoF" />

==Personality and traits==
Gorn Vorrox was a friendly sort to all outward appearances, but in reality he was an opportunistic [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]], as well as a skilled negotiator and shrewd salesperson.<ref name="SoF" />
